# Soul Hunt

> Soul Hunt is a free anime action RPG on Roblox by GGSK. Hunt spirit beasts, absorb the Remnant they leave to earn a Ring (Grade I to IV), and fight other players for theirs. Four Souls to awaken, world and field bosses, PvP. Thai and English.

## Pages

- [Home](https://soulhunt.ggsk.dev/): what the game is, the four Souls, the bosses and a gameplay clip.
- [Guide](https://soulhunt.ggsk.dev/guide.html): every Ring, Soul, monster, boss and build, with the game's own numbers.
- [Updates](https://soulhunt.ggsk.dev/updates.html): every patch since launch, newest first.
- [Privacy & contact](https://soulhunt.ggsk.dev/privacy.html): what the site and the game collect, and how to reach the developer.
